decisionContext: The owner had just been told the next step was to ship the 48 newly approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus, then replied "yes please continue".
summary: One conversation can make the next decision impossible to keep vague.
body: One conversation can make the next decision impossible to keep vague. When Mercury conjuncts the North Node, a message, application, introduction, contract term, or answer to one important question can put a concrete choice where speculation had been. You may still need time to decide, but now you know what you are deciding about. Get the date, amount, requirement, name, or answer that changes your options, then stop planning around information you no longer need to guess at.
